title: Could Hypothyroidism Be Raising Your Cholesterol?
description: Up to 30% of adults with high cholesterol also have undiagnosed low thyroid — here’s how to spot the signs and ask your doctor.
perplexityQuestions: What does it mean if my LDL is high but my total cholesterol is under 200?
Can I have normal cholesterol and still get a heart attack or stroke?
What is lipoprotein(a), and should adults over 35 get it tested once?
What is apolipoprotein B, and is it better than LDL for risk assessment?
Why is my triglycerides number high even if my LDL is normal?
competitorCoverage: Top-ranking adult cholesterol articles usually explain what cholesterol is, how LDL/HDL/triglycerides differ, what lab numbers mean, and the main risks of high cholesterol for heart attack and stroke.[1][2][3] They also tend to cover common causes, basic lifestyle changes, when to test, and when medication may be needed, so a competitive article should add nuanced risk markers like non-HDL cholesterol, apoB, lipoprotein(a), fasting vs nonfasting testing, secondary causes, and when imaging or statins are considered.[4][5][8][9][10]
